requirements.title: GPS App Scheduled at 5 Hz
requirements.description: The GPS app shall execute on the static schedule at 5 Hz throughout the mission.
requirements.rationale: Parent SW-REQ-SYS-009 fixes GPS rate at 5 Hz; the app realizes that cadence at the View layer.

requirements.title: Read NMEA Messages from GPS Library
requirements.description: The GPS app shall read NMEA messages from the GPS library on each scheduled execution.
requirements.rationale: Parent SW-REQ-SYS-009 requires sampling the GPS receiver; the app pulls data via gps_lib at its rate.

requirements.title: Delegate NMEA Parsing to NMEA Library
requirements.description: The GPS app shall delegate NMEA sentence parsing to the NMEA library.
requirements.rationale: Architecture-layering constraint derived from ai/memory/architecture.md (View vs Controller separation): apps are the View layer and contain no business logic, so parsing belongs to nmea_lib (Controller). Not a SYS L1 decomposition.

requirements.title: Publish Structured GPS Fix on Software Bus
requirements.description: The GPS app shall publish a structured GPS fix message on the software bus on each successful parse.
requirements.rationale: Parent SW-REQ-SYS-038 and SW-REQ-SYS-039 require geodetic position with HAE altitude available to consumers via the bus.

requirements.title: Publish Raw NMEA Bytes on Software Bus
requirements.description: The GPS app shall publish the raw NMEA sentence bytes on the software bus without modification.
requirements.rationale: Parent SW-REQ-SYS-024 requires verbatim NMEA logging; the app provides the verbatim bytes to mlog_lib via the bus.

requirements.title: Publish GPS Health Status
requirements.description: The GPS app shall publish a GPS health status on the software bus on each scheduled execution.
requirements.rationale: Parent SW-REQ-SYS-031 requires continuous per-sensor health observability for sys_app aggregation.

requirements.title: Report GPS Unhealthy on Read Failure
requirements.description: The GPS app shall report GPS unhealthy in its published health status when a GPS read fails.
requirements.rationale: Parent SW-REQ-SYS-031 requires health reflect actual sensor state so sys_app aggregates an accurate bitmap.

requirements.title: POSIX and Pico2 Functional Equivalence
requirements.description: The GPS app shall produce identical bus messages on POSIX and Pico2 builds given identical inputs.
requirements.rationale: Parent SW-REQ-SYS-043 requires POSIX functional equivalence to the Pico2 flight build for Trick anchoring.

requirements.title: Raw GPS Bytes Available for Logging
requirements.description: The GPS app shall provide raw NMEA bytes on the software bus for SD card logging consumers.
requirements.rationale: Parent SW-REQ-SYS-001 requires raw sensor logging to the SD card; the GPS app makes raw NMEA bytes available on the bus for the logging consumer.

requirements.title: HAE Altitude in Published GPS Fix
requirements.description: The GPS app shall publish GPS altitude referenced to the WGS-84 ellipsoid.
requirements.rationale: Parent SW-REQ-SYS-039 mandates HAE as the FSW altitude reference; the GPS app's published fix must use that reference.
